title: Thorned Heart Demon
description: A monochrome demonic figure with multiple arms sits cross-legged inside a large white heart shape. The heart is encircled by sharp black thorns and drips white liquid against a textured dark red background.
prompt: A multi-armed demonic figure wearing a crown sits in lotus position inside a large spiked heart. The demon holds a scale, a knife, and other objects. The white heart has sharp black thorns protruding outward and white liquid dripping down. Dark red textured background with subtle golden bokeh lights, dark surreal horror style, high contrast black and white figure on red field.
